collection.description: A child finds leaves of different shades beneath a tree.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) finds leaves of different shades beneath a tree.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a naturalist, describes changes in leaf pigments.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) notices that not every tropical tree changes color at once.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) sorts leaves by shade without picking living ones.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) discovers insects sheltering beneath the leaves.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (child) arranges a colorful pattern on the ground.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The wind scatters the picture and inspires a new design.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) shares a seasonal saying and admits it is not a rule.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) compares the saying with what the trees actually do.
